text:
The European Court of Human Rights held, by a Grand Chamber majority of 9 to 8, that the UK did not violate Article 6(1) (right of access to a court). The UK courts had correctly applied state immunity under the State Immunity Act 1978 to bar Mr Al-Adsani's torture damages claim against Kuwait, and the Court found that this pursued a legitimate aim and was proportionate. The Court also found no violation of Article 3 or Article 13.

CONFIDENCE: 85
